scripts.bootstrap: (command -v agent-browser > /dev/null 2>&1 || (npm install -g agent-browser && agent-browser install)) && cd frontend && nci --silent

init_hook: for hook in pre-commit pre-push post-merge; do hook_path=$(git rev-parse --git-path hooks/$hook); test -x "$hook_path" && grep -Fqx "call_lefthook run \"$hook\" \"\$@\"" "$hook_path" || { lefthook install; break; }; done
[ -d frontend/node_modules ] || echo 'Run devbox run bootstrap to install development tools and frontend dependencies.'
